text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Constitutional Court sets January 8 to rule on a request by parliament to examine the legality of the speakership election procedures challenged by a former finance minister MP Jassem al-Kharafi.
- Parliamentarian wants state subsidy for salaries of Kuwaitis working for the private sector. Most of Kuwait's national workforce is hired by the state.
- Year-end company results boost trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange.
- State prosecutor wants crack down on narcotics dealers.
- Oman's foreign minister says Muscat favours bilateral solution to the territorial dispute between Qatar and Bahrain.
- Gulf Arab states, Egypt and Syria voice concern over Iranian missiles in the Gulf.
